request.style: English, Male baritone solo with backing choir, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, cello, solemn and reverent, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Philistines held the gate strong
David waited in the cave deep
Three chief men heard the longing song
And rose while the harvest was ripe

[Chorus]
Pour it out to the Lord above
It is blood of the men who died
Do not drink from this cup of love
For their lives are the price paid

[Verse]
They broke through the enemy camp
And drew water from the well
The risk was great and the danger damp
But they carried it back to tell

[Chorus]
Pour it out to the Lord above
It is blood of the men who died
Do not drink from this cup of love
For their lives are the price paid

[Bridge]
Far be it from me to take
This sacrifice of their blood
The mighty men went at the risk
And gave their lives to God

[Outro]
Such were the exploits of the three
Refusing to drink the water
Honor the risk of the men for me
And keep the holy order
